# Netra Privacy Guard (SensorGuard)

> Free Android app by Prayagi Store and Services: microphone/camera transparency and privacy monitoring, on-device.

## Pages
- [Home](https://prayagi-store-and-services.github.io/prayagi-Privacy-/): features and download.
- [Legal & data](https://prayagi-store-and-services.github.io/netra-eco/legal/): privacy policy and data safety.
